statements.impact_statement: Ubuntu USN-8996-1 (https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8996-1) fixes CVE-2026-109518 in Ubuntu 26.04 APT 3.2.1ubuntu0.1. The official amd64 apt archive SHA256 is 0de729b8fe0e1c67c04e8e8d5bd6e0420dbd47f75b93f0b71c8e740edc2d5ffc; libapt-pkg7.0 is 94e5d41303265b66af0f8c70ade18bfb77260ad286edee6c8045faddef82b94c. Both exact packages are installed before the first APT operation. CI binds the native installed pair, every package-owned ELF byte hash, raw scanner package identity and this exact PURL set to the same Dapper image. Other versions, architectures, distributions, packages and CVEs are not covered.

Canonical documents this backport as fixed in 0.10.0-1ubuntu2~26.04.1. https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/rust-coreutils-0-10-now-available-for-ubuntu-26-04-lts/88120; https://ubuntu.com/security/cves/CVE-2026-35341.json explicitly confirms the updates-pocket fix for CVE-2026-35341 while the security-pocket status lags. Official amd64 archive SHA256 963dbc5efa92141e7056a9e9f3431ec7f352f2a7c762f2b3242443df39be9115; installed /usr/bin/coreutils ELF SHA256 f84e76ea4da1e0c4e92254bd0d7dccdabe2c8b3098e734f27997dae3ee5d8e02. CI must verify the same Dapper image, installed package and bytes before using native Trivy OpenVEX. No other version, architecture, distribution, package or CVE is covered.
